name: ModelVariant372_HandleRequest
evidence: matching model_variant/variant372_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4 (eight ribbons fan out from a model joint while sixteen sheets unfold, then the slot fades to its target ambient. Retail copies two path strings into locals it never reads.  The US build is GCC 2.7.2 (the `jr ra; nop` epilogue and the local-allocated struct-copy scratches); the French header-389 build of the same source is GCC 2.8.1 and only moves the CLUT column. Matching quirks: the orbit loop reuses `angle` for its first phase, the odd-ribbon angle is written from `n` so loop strength reduction creates the spilled 1024 step, and the phase test is inverted so `result = 4` comes first); for a non-negative request it sets the effect up from the command row indexed by the request, otherwise it runs one frame; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the French header-389/539 images build the same source through french_model_variant/variant389_entry.c with VERSION_FRENCH, with the sheets helper and data labels bound 0x3C later. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
